import numpy as np, torch, model
net=model.load()
xi=torch.tensor(np.load('cache_xi.npy')); cn=np.load('cache_c.npy'); m=np.load('cache_m.npy'); c=torch.tensor(cn)
y=torch.tensor(((m==0)&(cn>0.55)&(cn<0.95)).astype(np.float32))
t=torch.ones(len(c))
srcs=("blocks.0.act","blocks.1.act","blocks.2.act","out_act","blocks.2")
v,F=net.velocity(xi,t,c,capture=srcs)
ntr=24000
res={}
for s in srcs:
    X=F[s]; mu=X[:ntr].mean(0); sd=X[:ntr].std(0)+1e-6; Z=(X-mu)/sd
    w=torch.zeros(Z.shape[1],requires_grad=True); b=torch.zeros(1,requires_grad=True)
    opt=torch.optim.Adam([w,b],lr=0.05)
    for it in range(1500):
        opt.zero_grad(); l=torch.nn.functional.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(Z[:ntr]@w+b,y[:ntr],pos_weight=torch.tensor(1.0))+1e-4*(w**2).sum(); l.backward(); opt.step()
    with torch.no_grad():
        s_=Z@w+b; yt=y[ntr:].bool()
        for thr in [0,1,2]:
            p=s_[ntr:]>thr
            print(s, thr, 'recall',(p&yt).sum().item()/yt.sum().item(),'false pos rate',(p&~yt).sum().item()/len(yt))
    res[s]=(w.detach()/sd, (b - (w.detach()/sd*mu).sum()).detach())
    torch.save(res,'det.pt')

import numpy as np, torch, model
net=model.load()
res=torch.load('det.pt'); dw,db=res['blocks.1.act']
def phi(c): return 72*c-46
def modeidx(a,c):
    th=np.degrees(np.arctan2(a[:,1],a[:,0])); d=(th-(180+phi(c))+180)%360-180
    return np.round(d/45).astype(int)%8
def mk(sign):
    R=torch.tensor([[0.,-sign],[sign,0.]])
    return model._Graft(dict(layer='out',det_source='blocks.1.act',det_w=dw.float(),det_b=float(db),det_thr=0.0,k_range=(0,1),
        src='x',w_in=torch.eye(2),b_in=torch.zeros(2),act='linear',w_out=(-20*(R-torch.eye(2))).float()))
torch.manual_seed(7); N=20000
xi=torch.randn(N,2); c=torch.rand(N); cn=c.numpy()
net.grafts=[]; a0=np.asarray(model.decode(net,xi,c)); m0=modeidx(a0,cn)
for sgn in [1,-1]:
    net.grafts=[mk(sgn)]; a1=np.asarray(model.decode(net,xi,c)); m1=modeidx(a1,cn)
    mv=np.linalg.norm(a1-a0,axis=1)>0.3
    for lo,hi in [(0,.5),(.5,.55),(.55,.75),(.75,.95),(.95,1)]:
        s=(cn>=lo)&(cn<hi)
        print(sgn,lo,hi,'m0 share before',(m0[s]==0).mean().round(3),'after',(m1[s]==0).mean().round(3),
              'moved',mv[s].mean().round(3),'moved nonbad',(mv&(m0!=0))[s].mean().round(4),
              'dest',np.bincount(m1[s&mv],minlength=8))
    r=np.linalg.norm(a1,axis=1); r0=np.linalg.norm(a0,axis=1)
    print('radius out [2,4] before',((r0<2)|(r0>4)).mean(),'after',((r<2)|(r>4)).mean())
